title: Selection by protection in the digestion-driven predator ecology: when two predator kinds interconvert only in solution, the material of the kind that hunts (stays condensed) rises to 2.6-4.6x the other's on two seeds, while the conversion-everywhere control stays at exactly 1.00 and the neutral twin drifts to 0.75 and 1.33
summary: world2m.py is world2p.py (20261027T0457-c52-predator-competition-taxis: two conserved predator kinds b and e, each condensing only up its own digestion product) plus a symmetric interconversion that reads nothing about kind: net conversion to b = mconv (1 - min(1, (c_b + c_e)/0.5)) (c_e - c_b), i.e. only where predator material is dissolved; bodies keep their kind and hand it to both daughters when they divide. mdrive.py (128^2, t=12000, equal amounts at t=2000, mconv 1e-3) records each kind's total material. Selective arm (e has c46's taxis 0.5, b none): e/b = 3.65 (seed 0) and 2.65 (seed 1) at t=12000, plateau 3.5-4.7 from t~4500; with 3x faster conversion 3.61; with b at half taxis 4.57. Conversion everywhere (gate 0, same selective kinds): e/b = 1.000 on both seeds. Neutral (both kinds taxis 0.5, gated): 0.75 and 1.33, so the gate also amplifies chance differences. In every selective arm kind b ends with 0 bodies and kind e with 30-46 (selection.png, right: share of predator bodies).

finding.operator: kind-blind interconversion of two conserved predator materials, gated off inside condensed bodies
finding.control: same selective kinds with conversion everywhere (gate 0); neutral twin with equal kinds; two seeds each
finding.result: e/b at t=12000: selective 3.65/2.65, gate-off 1.000/1.000, neutral 0.75/1.33

limits: This is not differential reproduction: no kind makes more of its own material; the hunting kind gains material because its material spends more time in bodies, where conversion is off, while the dissolved amounts of the two kinds equalize. Bodies inherit the kind through division, but the kind's share changes through the bath, so a reviewer may call it a mutation-partition balance rather than heredity with selection. Two kinds only, no new variants; 128^2, two seeds per arm, one conversion gate (threshold 0.5); counts from drive-style recording, not labkit packs. Neutral drift is large (0.75-1.33), so differences of less than ~1.5x would not be distinguishable with two seeds.
